## New this pass (2026-10-12 planning pass, newest-3) — found and fixed an orphaned-watchdog bug; #310 was stuck 3.5+ days

**Root-caused why the #282 stale-issue watchdog has silently never fired once in this project's
history, and used it to unstick a real 3.5-day orphaned issue:**

- **#310** was stuck in `agent-doing` since 2026-10-09T06:50 with zero further dispatcher
  activity (no WORK/VERIFY log line after that pass, no commit referencing #310, no new
  comment) — confirmed via `logs/dispatcher.log` + `gh api .../commits` for that window. This is
  exactly the multi-day silent stall the #282 watchdog (`watchdog_reconcile_stale_issues()` in
  `scripts/dispatcher.sh`) was built to catch automatically.
- **Root cause confirmed live:** the watchdog queries `gh issue list --label
  "agent-doing,agent-review"` — `gh issue list --label` treats a comma-separated value as a
  logical **AND** (issue must carry *both* labels at once), not OR. Since no issue ever has both
  labels simultaneously, this query always returns `[]`. `grep -c WATCHDOG
  logs/dispatcher.log` = 0 across the entire 14,000+ line log history — the watchdog has been a
  complete no-op since #282 landed.
- Manually relabeled #310 back to `agent-todo` (posted explanatory comment) rather than leave it
  orphaned further. Queued **#324** (`agent-todo`, unblocked) to fix the query (fetch each label
  separately and merge, rather than one combined-AND query) plus a manual verification step
  using the function's own documented `STALE_HOURS=0` test procedure.
- Checked other `agent-doing`/`agent-review` issues for the same pattern: **#323** is a normal
  in-flight crash-retry (1 crash so far, re-picked up, within documented #279 crash-rate range).
  No other stuck issues found.
- **#320/#321/#322** (all `agent-todo`): each has crashed 1-2 times already today per their
  comment history — all within the already-extensively-documented #279 crash-rate pattern, no
  new distinct failure shape, not re-flagged on #279 to avoid redundant noise on an already
  very long thread.
- `depends_on` re-walk: #268 confirmed `agent-todo` (deps #265/#267/#304 all CLOSED, correctly
  promoted by a prior pass). #120-126 chain unchanged, still transitively gated on #268 (open).
- **#279 / #294:** both re-read; no new client comment since the push-divergence-resolved
  writeup already on #279. Both remain open, non-blocking.
- No inbox items, no untriaged issues, no `agent-triage` issues, no new goal to decompose.

**Net board effect:** #310 relabeled `agent-doing`→`agent-todo` (unstuck), +1 new issue (#324,

## New this pass (2026-10-08 planning pass, latest x6)

**Root-caused why #311's fix hasn't actually cleared the standing push-divergence despite
repeated karen PASSES — one new fix issue queued (#317), two diagnostic comments posted
(#311, #279), no label changes otherwise.**

- `logs/dispatcher.log` showed `push_with_retry()` (the #311 fix, live in HEAD) hitting a real
  `CONFLICT (content)` in `src/App.tsx`/`src/simulation/rng.ts` on every attempt since 19:46Z
  today, each time falling through to "cannot auto-merge, push failed" — i.e. its own
  redundant-content auto-resolve path never triggers in practice.
- **Manually re-verified by hand this pass** (reading `git diff <merge-base> origin/main --
  <file>` and grepping every added line against `git show HEAD:<file>`) that the conflict genuinely
  IS fully redundant — every line origin's one unique commit (`5102783`, closes #180) added to
  both files already exists verbatim in current local HEAD. So the auto-resolve path *should*
  fire and doesn't — a bug in the new code, not a real conflict.
- **Root cause, found by reading `push_with_retry()` directly (scripts/dispatcher.sh ~131-217):**
  a whitespace-trim asymmetry. Lines origin added are extracted and trimmed of leading/trailing
  whitespace before comparison; the local file's content is captured untrimmed (original
  indentation intact); the match uses `grep -F -x` (exact whole-line match). Any indented line
  (i.e. nearly all real code inside a function/JSX block) can never match once one side is
  trimmed and the other isn't — so `all_redundant` flips `false` on essentially every real file,
  and the function always takes the "abort, real conflict" path regardless of actual redundancy.
- Queued **#317** (`agent-todo`, unblocked, narrowly scoped to this one comparison bug, explicit
  note not to touch #310's in-flight cooldown/fairness code in the same file) and posted full
  diagnosis to **#311** and a shorter cross-reference to **#279** (this is the concrete reason
  #305/#311's push-divergence fixes haven't resolved the divergence in practice yet).
- **Zero `depends_on` promotions due** (fresh re-walk this pass): #315→#314(open); #268→#265-267
  (closed)/#304(open); #120→#263-267(closed)/#268(open); #121-126→#120 or siblings(open);
  #155→#165-168,#276(closed)/#277(open); #158→#176,#285,#287,#288(closed)/#289,#314,#315(open).
  None due.
- No inbox items, no untriaged issues, no `agent-triage` issues, no new client answers on #279
  or #294 this pass. Both remain open, non-blocking.
